newsitem.title: UK: UK small business leaders back Labour Party.
newsitem.headline: UK small business leaders back Labour Party.

text.p: Eighty-four leaders of small British businesses on Friday endorsed the opposition Labour Party, tipped to win the May 1 general election.
"We believe that small business can look forward with confidence to a profitable future with a Labour government," they wrote in a letter to The Times newspaper.
The letter came on the day the Labour Party was due to launch its business manifesto.

A small business had gone bust every three minutes of every working day since 1992, the sector had been hit by 11 tax increases, and red tape had grown under the Conservative government, the company heads said.
"The present government has taken small firms for granted and has done too little to support us," they wrote.
The letter was signed by five company leaders, who said their sentiments were shared by 79 other heads of small businesses.
